verdict.rationale: Polar runs several billing processes on its own in the background: automatic subscription renewal, automated dunning retries on a fixed schedule, off-session charges and automatic seat proration. It also emits asynchronous webhooks, so users can drive their own downstream automations. These are fixed built-in behaviors or event hooks, not automations a user defines, and the MCP server only gives agents interactive access rather than scheduled autonomous runs. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or workflow builder, scheduled or recurring agent tasks, and native autonomous background agent execution.
